Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and the CSV. Sorry for the disruption to your AP team. I'm looping in Ben (billing ops) and Marissa (AM) so we can triage quickly.

Quick answers up front:
- Our attribution is primarily per-request with session stitching for streaming flows; edge cases occur when the client rotates keys (different API keys) or if a session_id is omitted/changed mid-stream.
- No scheduled infra changes were deployed in that window, but we did have a short migration job for session indexing on 2026-10-01 02:00 UTC (low risk) that touched the session-joiner service.

Ben — can you pull per-request logs (request_id, timestamp, api_key, model, tokens_in, tokens_out) for 2026-10-01 and 10-02 for account 9982 and share a sanitized snippet? Also please include any evidence of repeated request_ids or rapid key rotations.

Marissa — I'll coordinate the customer-facing note and provisional remediation.

Hi all —

I pulled the per-request export and ran a quick pass. Summary findings (attached snippet):
- There are ~3.4k requests on Oct 1 between 01:50–02:10 UTC that have identical request_ids but differing api_key values (two distinct keys observed) — these correspond to your account id 9982.
- A small percentage (~6%) of streaming sessions appear to have dropped session_id and reconnected within 2–3s, which our stitcher treats as new requests in the billing path.
- No model-side kernel changes were rolled during that range; model names and token counts look consistent.

Preliminary hypothesis: a transient session-indexer migration job at 02:00 UTC caused short-lived re-issuing of API keys for some connections in your environment (or your client rotated keys). That mixed key attribution and duplicated request_ids caused requests to be double-counted for billing.

Attachments: redwood_token_log_snippet.txt (sanitized 500-line sample)

Next steps I recommend:
1) We can run a full dedupe against the duplicated request_ids and propose a provisional credit (calculation attached).
2) If you can confirm whether your client rotated API keys or toggled any streaming reconnect behavior in that window, that will help.

Ben
